description: This file defines the 'UniqueKey' class, a core data structure in Orleans that represents a unique identifier for grains, system targets, and clients. It includes methods for parsing, creating, comparing, and serializing keys, along with handling different categories and extended key features.

classes.name: UniqueKey
classes.description: Sealed class representing a unique identifier for Orleans grains and system entities, supporting parsing, comparison, serialization, and conversion to string formats. It encodes category information and key components, including optional extensions.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string or span into a UniqueKey instance, supporting hex string and GUID formats.

methods.name: NewKey
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating new UniqueKey instances with various parameters like GUID, ulong components, category, and extension.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyToLong
methods.description: Converts the primary key to a long integer, optionally returning the extension string.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyToGuid
methods.description: Converts the primary key to a GUID, optionally returning the extension string.
